I am an old woman now, 68 years, and my plot is small — only 0.31 hectares of beans here in Zomba. My strength is not what it was, so I depend mostly on my own hands and maybe my grandchildren when they come. For beans, I do not buy chemical fertilizer — beans make their own goodness in the soil, and the FISP coupons when they come I save for the maize plot. I will put some manure from my chickens, use the seed I kept from last harvest, and pray the rains are kind.
